description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade operations in an OpenWRT build environment, including image validation, partition management, copying configuration to partitions, and EFI system partition upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the partition layout of a given upgrade image and compares it with the current device to determine if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a designated partition on the device during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Handles the updating of EFI System Partition files (like boot loaders) from the upgrade image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the main upgrade logic, including partition table handling, writing disk images, and updating boot configurations.
